answer: Re-attestations are stored in juniper and ripple lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 5 epochs, so holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the harbor graph. Verification costs 3 dollars and 3 days per identity, which turns a 4099 account sybil into a 8 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
